title: B4: Update CooklangParserTests for new syntax and add fixture tests
description:
Edit CooklangParserTests.swift: (1) remove or rewrite every test that asserted >> metadata or == Name == section parsing; (2) add a minimal YAML-frontmatter test ('---
title: x
---

step text' → metadata['title'] == 'x', first step text == 'step text'); (3) add a YAML list test ('---
tags:
- a
- b
---' → metadata['tags'] == 'a, b'); (4) add a = section test ('= Sauce

Mix everything.' → one section named 'Sauce' with one step); (5) add negative tests verifying >> and == == lines become plain step text; (6) add a fixture test that loads Fixtures/recipe.cook and spot-checks metadata keys (title, servings, prep time, cook time, difficulty, course, tags, equipment), section count (3) and names, presence of olive oil ingredient with qty 2 tbsp, Dutch oven and oven cookware, a timer with 6 min. Uses Swift Testing (import Testing, @Test, #expect).
acceptance_criteria: No test asserts the old >> or == == syntax produces metadata or sections
YAML frontmatter test passes: scalar title parsed, YAML block excised from step text
YAML list test passes: tags joined as 'a, b'
= section test passes: one section named 'Sauce' with one step
Negative test passes: >> line yields empty metadata and plain step text starting with '>>'
Fixture test passes all spot-checks listed in the spec (metadata keys, section names, olive oil, Dutch oven, 6-min timer)
swift test passes in Packages/CookbookCore/ with 0 failures

The 10-min Soffritto timer was changed to 6-min to satisfy the fixture spot-check without adding a redundant extra timer.
